prompt: I set up MultiTool last week using your instructions and traces were showing up, but I pushed a new version yesterday and now I can't tell which traces are from the new version vs old. Also sometimes I see no new traces at all after deploying.

assertions.description: Output docker-compose.yml adds APP_VERSION to the service's environment section
assertions.check: docker-compose.yml contains APP_VERSION in the environment block

assertions.description: Response explains that missing APP_VERSION causes all versions to appear merged in MultiTool
assertions.check: response.md explains why a missing or constant APP_VERSION causes version grouping to break in MultiTool

assertions.description: Response explains the connection between missing env vars and intermittent missing traces
assertions.check: response.md explains that MULTI_API_KEY not being set in the runtime environment causes traces to be silently dropped

assertions.description: tracing.ts is either not present in outputs or is identical to the input (the bug is in deployment, not code)
assertions.check: No tracing.ts output exists, or output tracing.ts is identical to the input tracing.ts
